_help: Portable completed editing style for one channel. Keep the keys stable. Lists can grow. 'tool_support' says when the tool follows a rule: now = already works, fix = requires planned code support, llm = requires the AI Director.
name: Forgotten Flavors of USA
audience: Americans 50+ who remember mid-century and 1970s home cooking, plus younger viewers interested in forgotten American food history
mood: nostalgic, fast-moving, curious, investigative, slightly dramatic, appetising when food is shown

topic_inheritance.rule: Keep the channel's editing language consistent while selecting visuals, facts and archival material specifically for each script.

pacing._help: How long one visual stays on screen (seconds).
slow_down_on: the last line of an item
pacing._rule: Every channel (Ishaq, 3 Oct): a sentence up to 7 s is one clip; a longer one is cut into equal parts of 3-7 s, each from a different video; nothing under 3 s after the hook.

structure._help: What each part of the video must do.

chapter_card.when: only where the script has an item heading

each_item.ingredients_card: one ingredients card per item, on the first line that lists the ingredients
each_item.story_lines: shots of the same dish (being made or served)
each_item.history_lines: period photos or period footage of the dish if they exist, else the dish
each_item.last_shot: finished dish or people enjoying it

subscribe_reminder.when: once after the hook and once in the outro only
subscribe_reminder.style: small channel button; never cover the food

outro.show: a quick recap of the strongest finished-dish shots, ending on the most nostalgic image

scene_rules._help: What to show for each KIND of sentence. The tool picks the first rule that matches.

rules.when_sentence_has: a route, movement between places, or a location essential to understanding the story
a place or region mentioned only as background context
rules.show: relevant footage or archival photo; do not automatically show a map

rules.when_sentence_has: a span of years (e.g. '1950s to the 1980s')

rules.show: clip of exactly that step if found, else the dish being made
period photo or home-movie style footage
a fading family recipe card, closed cookbook, empty serving plate, or period photo; avoid unrelated empty shelves
verified archival packaging or a neutral dish shot; never generate a logo

rules.when_sentence_has: a number, ranking, temperature, duration, or quantity
rules.show: a short readable fact graphic only when the number is important

footage._help: Where visuals come from, in the order the tool tries them.
footage.on_insufficient_real_footage: mark item as needs_footage and block automatic final export; do not silently fill the item with AI images

visual_mix._help: Target mix for a normal completed item. The validator may allow small changes when authentic material is scarce.

repetition._help: Stops the video from feeling repetitive.
repetition.same_moment_of_a_source_twice: only mirrored or inside an old TV, for a scene that found no footage of its own; never a loop

photos.motion: slow push-in or pan; never static
photos.frame: full-screen; product photos may use a clean cutout on a deep red, magenta, cream, or dark neutral background; no scrapbook or polaroid frame

never_show._help: Anything here is refused by the clip checker.
people: recognisable AI face repeated with inconsistent identity
places: modern stainless-steel kitchen when the shot claims to be historical
obviously contemporary restaurant when the narration describes a 1970s home kitchen
other: a different dish than the item

motion_graphics._help: Graphics allowed on this channel and how often. Designs must exist in the library; missing ones are reported, never faked.

look._help: Colour and texture of the whole video.
look.grain: none globally; preserve the natural grain of archival material
look.colour: clean, contrasty and vivid; preserve original archival colours instead of applying a global sepia grade
look.vignette: none globally; a subtle dark overlay may appear only behind important text

transitions._help: How one shot changes to the next.
transitions.into_chapter_card: hard cut or very short dissolve; never insert an empty frame

captions.position: center or upper-center, chosen to avoid covering the subject
captions.animation: quick fade or pop; no karaoke highlight
captions.font: Impact or Anton; Arial Black or Arial Bold fallback on Windows
captions.colour: bright yellow with a thick black outline and subtle black shadow
captions.mode: important facts and punch lines only, not continuous captions

text.long_text: shrink then wrap to two lines, never cut

highlight_word.style: bright yellow uppercase with black outline; use orange rectangular labels with white uppercase text for names and sources

text.key_phrase_pop_ups: roughly one every 8-15 seconds when the narration contains a strong fact or punch line; normally 3-8 words
text.cursive_rule: never use cursive in this channel style
text.source_label: small orange rectangle with white uppercase text, placed near the lower left or next to the referenced product

ai_images._help: Only when nothing real exists. Prompts follow these rules.
ai_images.look: match the script's actual era and source type; use a clean product/documentary composition, not a generic vintage kitchen
ai_images.people: never: no people, faces or full-kitchen wide shots; the food fills the frame (hands without faces at most)

checker._help: Extra rules the AI checker applies to every clip, besides 'never_show'.
accept_if: the exact cooking action matches the narration
a clean appetising shot of the correct dish supports a non-procedural line
a verified period image supports a historical claim
warn_if: the same source dominates more than 20 seconds
the same composition appears three times in ten scenes
a historical claim is illustrated only by generated imagery

quality_gates._help: Final automatic checks before the video may be exported.
block_export_if: an item has no real video and no approved exception
real video share for an item is below 0.65
a selected clip shows the wrong dish
a historical scene contains an obvious modern device
generated imagery contains a brand logo
a caption is clipped, outside safe margins, or below minimum size
a transition contains a blank frame
quality_gates.approved_exception_requires: a saved reason plus manual approval for genuinely unavailable archival subjects

parallel_processing._help: Bounded concurrency for speed without increasing provider blocks.

sound._help: Not used by the tool yet; written down for later.
sound.music: low documentary pulse with light suspense, restrained retro colour, and clear forward momentum; instrumental beneath narration
sound.sound_effects: subtle whoosh or impact on major yellow fact overlays and quiet archival texture where appropriate; no page-turn scrapbook effects or cartoon pops
